newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Becker half year net rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Becker half year net rises.

text.p: Film and video production group Becker Group Ltd said on Monday its unaudited net profit for the half year to end-December was up 16.1 percent to A$2.23 million.
This was struck on total revenue of A$18.55 million, while earnings before interest and tax and net profit before tax were both higher at A$3.03 million and A$3.50 million respectively.
The company said a complete half yearly report would be released on completion of the auditor's report.
By 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT), Becker Group shares were six cents higher at A$1.34 on light turnover of 23,000 shares.
